children: Overview
Sweden commercial property owner's rental income rose 1% for Jan–Sep 2026
Income from property management grew 5% for the nine-month period
Company repurchased SEK 68 mln of its own shares in the quarter
Outlook
Company says it is scaling up investment in Industrial and Logistics as planned
Result Drivers
RENTAL INCOME GROWTH - Co said rental income and operating surplus increased in the quarter
INVESTMENT IN INDUSTRIAL AND LOGISTICS - Co said it scaled up investment volume in industrial and logistics properties
PROJECT LAUNCH - Co launched Arendal 5.0 development project in industrial and logistics
